scope: Raw losses, coefficients and weighted contributions across every training objective.
coverage: Budget students: GT position/velocity/rotation/angular velocity; teacher-state counterparts; aggregate and three-group correction KD; all four JEPA terms with effective outer weights.
Main training: embedding prediction/content/variance/covariance; RGB L1, x/y edges and x/y flow; state SL; optional auxiliary teacher; internal correction KD.
PPO: actor/value/anchor and their weighted contributions, underlying MSE/divergence, clipped/unclipped surrogate diagnostics and clip fraction; validation state components.
aggregation: Detached sample-weighted means; conversion to scalar logs after aggregation.
invariance: Tests reconstruct weighted objective totals and verify unchanged gradients; no objective coefficients, validation criteria or deployment code changed.
limitations: Loss magnitudes do not measure per-term gradient influence or establish optimal coefficients.
No long training run started or existing history backfilled.
